officialText:
Licensees shall promptly notify the department in writing of any address, telephone number and/or electronic mail change within 30 days of the change. Licensees shall notify the department in writing of any criminal conviction within 10 days of the occurrence.

(L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)

Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.
